    The Peirce isomorphism A ≅ End(⊕ e_i A)ᵒᵖ #

    For a complete set of orthogonal idempotents e_i, the right ideals e_i A with the maps between them recover A: Hom_A(e_i A, e_j A) ≅ e_j A e_i by left multiplication, and A = ⊕ e_j A e_i. In our path-order convention for category algebras this is an algebra isomorphism A ≅ (Alg (i ↦ e_i A))ᵒᵖ (peirceEquiv). It is used to identify a basic algebra with the algebra A₀ of its projective labels (Corollary 5.5, mesh-deformations.tex: "Restrict the resulting isomorphism ind(mod A) ≅ C to the labelled projective objects and take opposite algebras").
